note: Documented combinations of existing ToolNest tools (see /tools.json) into common end-to-end workflows, with an integration example showing the deterministic parts reproduced via toolnest-core.

recipes.title: Student Academic Recipe
recipes.goal: Go from raw semester marks to a final GPA, a letter grade, and whether you qualify for a merit scholarship.
inputFlow: Enter per-course grade points and credit hours into student-academic-toolkit to compute GPA
Enter overall marks obtained/total into marks-grade-calculator to get a percentage and letter grade
Enter your institution's tuition fee and the scholarship percentage tier your grade qualifies for into discount-scholarship-calculator
recipes.outputFlow: GPA (student-academic-toolkit) -> percentage/letter grade (marks-grade-calculator) -> discounted fee amount (discount-scholarship-calculator)
limitations: Scholarship eligibility tiers (which percentage a given grade unlocks) vary by institution and are not encoded here — the tools compute the math, not the eligibility policy.
GPA scale assumed is 0-4.0; institutions on a different scale (e.g. 0-5) should adjust gradePoints accordingly before calling calculateGPA.

recipes.title: Property Investment Recipe
recipes.goal: Go from a raw plot size to a standardized area, a construction cost estimate, a monthly loan EMI, and the expected rental yield if you rent it out.
inputFlow: Enter plot size and unit into land-plot-toolkit to get a standardized area (sq ft / Marla / Kanal)
Enter covered area and construction grade/rate into construction-cost-estimator for a build cost estimate
Enter total financing needed, interest rate and tenure into property-loan-mortgage-calculator for the monthly EMI
Enter expected annual rental income and property value into rental-yield-calculator for the yield percentage
recipes.outputFlow: Standardized area (land-plot-toolkit) -> estimated cost (construction-cost-estimator) -> monthly EMI (property-loan-mortgage-calculator) -> rental yield % (rental-yield-calculator)
limitations: Construction cost estimation depends on regional material/labour rates entered by the user in construction-cost-estimator; toolnest-core does not encode regional pricing.
Rental yield here is gross yield (annual rent / property value). It does not subtract maintenance, taxes or vacancy — treat it as a starting estimate, not net ROI.

recipes.title: Freelancer / Small Business Finance Recipe
recipes.goal: Go from a raw invoice amount to a tax-compliant invoice and a monthly savings target from that income.
inputFlow: Enter the base amount and applicable tax rate into sales-tax-gst-calculator to get the tax amount and total
Enter client details, line items and the calculated total into invoice-generator to produce a PDF invoice
Enter a savings target (e.g. the total invoice amount) and a deadline into savings-goal-calculator for the required monthly saving
recipes.outputFlow: Tax amount + total (sales-tax-gst-calculator) -> formatted invoice PDF (invoice-generator) -> required monthly saving (savings-goal-calculator)
limitations: Tax rate (GST/sales tax) varies by jurisdiction and must be entered by the user — toolnest-core does not hardcode any country's tax rules.
invoice-generator produces the formatted PDF client-side; it is not callable as a pure function since PDF layout/rendering is not a deterministic data transform in the same sense as the calculators.
